answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fcd.business_date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT 
  dim_branch.city_name AS branch_city, 
  COUNT(fact_atm_transaction.atm_transaction_fact_key) AS atm_transaction_count 
FROM 
  bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction 
JOIN 
  bank_dwh.dim_branch ON fact_atm_transaction.branch_key = dim_branch.branch_key 
JOIN 
  bank_dwh.dim_date ON fact_atm_transaction.business_date_key = dim_date.date_key 
WHERE 
  dim_date.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' 
GROUP BY 
  dim_branch.city_name;

SELECT AVG(fabd.closing_balance_amount) AS average_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fabd JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fabd.business_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.fx_rate_daily_fact_key.mid_rate) AS average_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.iso_alpha_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_month_code = '2025-12';

answers.sql:
SELECT
  d.month_number AS month,
  COUNT(f.card_dispute_fact_key) AS dispute_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
  d.month_number
ORDER BY
  d.month_number;

SELECT
  c.customer_segment_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM
  bank_dwh.dim_customer c
WHERE
  c.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY
  c.customer_segment_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS inactive_customers_2025 FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c WHERE c.customer_key NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT fat.customer_key FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025)

SELECT
  ch.display_name AS channel_name,
  SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_channel ch ON fat.channel_key = ch.channel_key
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
  ch.display_name;

SELECT SUM(fcd.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fcd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fcd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily fldd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fldd.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = '2025-08-31'
  AND fldd.days_past_due > 90;

SELECT
  dlp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(fld.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement fld
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_loan_product dlp ON fld.loan_product_key = dlp.loan_product_key
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fld.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_date = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  dlp.display_name;

SELECT TOP 3 m.merchant_category_code, SUM(fca.original_amount) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m ON fca.merchant_key = m.merchant_key

GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
